notes: Refined existing stories for clarity, specificity, and tighter alignment to code artifacts. No new IDs created.

change_log.value: Explicit parallel orchestration, aggregation rules, and normalization into canonical envelope
Explicit tool names, allowlisting, and agent loop compatibility
Defined error taxonomy, partial success handling, and fallback rules
Expanded to include schema validation, orchestration paths, and failure scenarios

stories.title: Facade Input/Output Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define canonical request/response schemas including unified envelope (status, data, errors, metadata) with explicit extensibility hooks for additional Evaluate Care domains beyond trials and provider detail.

stories.title: Core Orchestration Logic for Trials and Provider Detail
stories.description: Implement facade orchestration logic routing to clinical_trials_service and provider_detail_service, supporting parallel execution where applicable, aggregation rules, and normalization into unified schema envelope.

stories.title: Tool Router Integration for Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Expose facade via tool_router with explicit allowlisted tool definitions (e.g., evaluate_trials, evaluate_provider_detail), strict Pydantic validation, and consistent response envelope compatible with main.py agent loop.

stories.title: Facade Error Handling and Response Normalization
stories.description: Implement shared error taxonomy and normalization layer including standardized error codes, partial success handling, and fallback behavior across clinical trials and provider detail domains.

stories.title: Facade Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating schema compliance, orchestration paths, tool_router invocation, partial failures, and cross-domain response consistency for trials and provider detail flows.
